crossRefs.note: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one…
The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared…

David struck also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”
translations.bsb: saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
translations.kjv: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
translations.asv: one saying to the sixth angel that had one trumpet, Loose the four angels that are bound at the great river Euphrates.
